name: curl in base image below 8.4.0 (CVE-2023-38545 class)
description: curl versions below 8.4.0 are affected by the SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow and related issues.
rationale: Widely-used outbound HTTP tooling with a memory-corruption CVE. NIST CM-2 baseline configuration includes the base image; SI-2 requires timely remediation. PCI DSS 6.3.3 requires critical patches within one month.
